value.title: Phase 1: reproduce, then refuse
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; stop-and-ask o-prime on anything outside the fence.

value.title: Reproduce the clobber and pin the writing path
value.success: a failing test shows which boot path rewrote daemon.key while another daemon owned the port (normal and --json); the path is named in the execution log
value.receipt: cargo test -p fs3-cli --test boot_contract another_loopback_address_family -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 with FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=:5434 anchor: RED 2/2; daemon B bound the other localhost address family and StagedAuth::publish rewrote daemon.key for normal and --json

value.title: Publish strictly after a successful bind on every boot path; no staged temp file survives a bind failure
value.success: key untouched on bind failure; temp file cleaned; guard mutation red
value.receipt: BoundListener private-field proof required by StagedAuth::publish; localhost canonicalized once to 127.0.0.1 before bind. Clobber tests green 2/2, fs3-daemon lib green 172/172; removing canonicalization made both clobber tests RED.

value.title: Honest 401 hint when the key is newer than the daemon
value.success: CLI names the overwrite + restart-the-owner fix
value.receipt: Auth records daemon.key mtime immediately after publication and reports key_newer_than_daemon only for strict >; live CLI rewrite test green and generic unchanged-key 401 asserts false. Reversing the mtime comparison made the live render test RED; restored and green.

value.title: Prod-database owner designation (FS3_PROD_OWNER / config owner path)
value.success: foreign cwd refuses prod URL with a helpful error; designated proceeds
value.receipt: DaemonConfig owner_root resolves from file/FS3_DAEMON__OWNER_ROOT. Boot refuses DEFAULT_URL before staging unless cwd inside root or FS3_PROD_OWNER=1. Config::default owner_root=None + foreign cwd is explicitly fail-closed; is_some_and->map_or(true) mutation RED, restored GREEN.

value.title: Regression + gate
value.success: suites green; clippy clean; CI green on the PR sha
value.receipt: Local harness checks status=ok at 2026-09-02T08:08:18.225Z; daemon lib 175/175. PR #108 CI gate green on rebased implementation head 04ad9a7 after run 33609408499; final progress-only commit reuses the same gate.

value.title: Real-usage transcript on the TEST setup + PR
value.success: two-daemon transcript with counts/mtimes in the PR body; exact prod commands for o-prime
value.receipt: TEST transcript: daemon A healthy on scratch config + per-run :5434 DB + port 63359; daemon B foreign cwd exited 1; A stayed authorized; key mtime/hash unchanged; no temp residue; DB dropped. PR #108 opened with ac-0001..ac-0005 receipts and exact prod bounce commands.

t1.assertion: test RED on main, names the path

t2.assertion: boot-sequence test green; publish-before-bind mutation red

t3.assertion: render test green; mtime-check mutation red

t4.assertion: boot test both ways; mutation red
